verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's own docs list webhook notification configuration for its checkout integration ('Configure notifications -- Webhooks and IPN'). Its official MCP server also lets AI-native users 'Configure and monitor Webhook notifications', so first-party outbound event subscriptions exist and can be managed from agent tooling. missing for 10: documented event types/topics catalog, payload and signature-verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
